policy.permissions: create,read,update,delete on all parish collections and their junctions; directus_files create,read,update
create,read,update own draft items only; presets status=draft; validation status in [draft]; no delete or publish

read only where status=published on announcements, events, mass_intentions, galleries, priests, parish_groups, homepage, sacraments; read linked directus_files; parish_pages read only where status=published

notes: Directus schema snapshots do not include roles, policies, or permissions. Apply schema.yaml with the Directus CLI, then create these Directus 12 policies and attach them to the built-in Administrator/Public roles and the Editor/Contributor roles through the /roles, /policies, and /permissions APIs.
